correctness.rationale: Set p odd prime, m=(p-1)/2, b0(d)=1, bj(d)=2cos(2πjd/p), Fourier spectral eigenvalues λj=2cos(2πj/p). The character sums S0=p,Q0=2p-1,Sd=0,Qd=p-1 for d!=0 are exact. Haar independent phases have zero offdiagonal correlation; uniform permutations of (m+1)st roots give -1/m, and 50:50 mixing c=-1/(p-1). Thus E Fd=((1-c)Qd+c Sd²)/p²=1/p at each d. Irreducibility of Φp proves independent frequency gaps λj-2, hence all tails of physical phase flow are dense on (S1)^m. Haar full support puts its barycenter in ri conv K; its midpoint with finite permutation barycenter is also relative interior, permitting exact physical finite convex combination via convex-density lemma; affine Carathéodory gives <=m+1 atoms with t>T. The analytic proof, not approximate numerical examples, establishes arbitrary p and all vertex pairs.
